title: cocculus prainianus
intro: Cocculus prainianus, commonly known as the Praine's Cocculus or Snakegourd, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, as well as aiding digestion and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cocculus prainianus include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
